personality_one_liner: A cinematic, expansive, and deeply reflective sanctuary that blends esoteric wisdom with premium, moody elegance.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for reading flow. No accidental empty space or orphan cards.

do's: Use blur/translucency on sticky headers, bottom tab bar, and featured hero cards
Apply gradient-to-dark scrim overlays on all images under text
Ensure text on glass has ≥75% tint opacity underneath for contrast
dont's: No glass on form inputs or body text regions
Do not stack more than two blurred surfaces on one screen

screens.name: Landing (Welcome)
screens.purpose: A single, confident, non-scrolling arrival moment.

states.error: Bottom anchored toast/snack with clear retry

screens.layout: Flex 1 full-screen structure using `justifyContent: 'space-between'`. Cinematic dark background photo with heavy top-to-bottom scrim. Confident wordmark 'The Mirror' at the top or center. A single primary CTA pinned to the safe-area bottom. Use a ScrollView only as a flexGrow safety net for small devices, but default intent is non-scrolling.

screens.name: Lens Deep Dive
screens.purpose: Immersive exploration of specific esoteric lenses (e.g., Human Design BodyGraph).

states.loading: Skeleton of the BodyGraph or chart outline
states.empty: No chart calculated yet – CTA to enter birth details
states.error: Unable to calculate chart – text message and retry button

screens.layout: Top hero area with abstract cosmic imagery and gradient scrim. Frosted glass segmented control (Reading | Explore) sticky underneath the header. In Explore mode, display the BodyGraph SVG centrally. Insight text should live in soft `surfaceSecondary` frosted cards with generous `md` or `lg` padding. Elegant serif headings (`2xl`) over sans-serif reading text (`base` or `lg` depending on density).

screens.name: Forum Member Mapping
screens.purpose: A visual compatibility map showing 'how this person maps to me'.

states.loading: Shimmer effect over two side-by-side blank avatars
states.empty: Select a user to map your charts

screens.layout: Top section features two profile avatars/initials side-by-side with a glowing connector line or unified orb motif. Below this, replace nested accordions with a clean, flat list of `surfaceSecondary` glass cards. If categories are needed, use a sticky pill-based horizontal filter row (e.g., Traits, Elements, Planets) rather than vertical accordions that clutter the screen.

welcome_hero_background.alt: A view of the night showing stars

instructions_to_main_agent: AUDIT TYPOGRAPHY: Ensure ALL text uses 'Cormorant Garamond' (displayFontFamily) for headers and 'Satoshi' (textFontFamily) for body/labels. Strip out all explicit 'bold', '600', '700', or '800' weights across the app. Cap font weight at 500 max. Use font sizes (sm, base, lg, xl, 2xl) from the typography scale to drive visual hierarchy.

FIX WELCOME/LANDING: Rebuild `welcome.tsx` to ensure it is a confident, single-page view. Ensure the brand name consistently says 'The Mirror'. Wrap the root in a full-height container using `justifyContent: 'space-between'` with proper safe-area padding at top and bottom. If a ScrollView must be used for small screens, ensure `contentContainerStyle={ flexGrow: 1 }` so the primary CTA is pushed to the bottom. Never leave the screen floating loosely.

FIX FORUM MEMBER MAPPING: This is the regression flashpoint. Replace the deeply nested accordions with a clean layout: Top section shows two user avatars side-by-side. Below, use a horizontal scrollable pill filter row or Segmented Control to tab through insight categories. Display insights in un-nested, elegantly padded `surfaceSecondary` glass cards. Ensure a standard gap (`lg`: 16) separates all cards to prevent the 'run together' look.

REVISE LENS DEEP DIVE: Unify the Reading and Explore modes. Wrap the toggle in an `expo-blur` segmented control. Keep the BodyGraph SVG intact on Explore mode, placed centrally over an abstract cosmic background (use gradient-to-dark scrim). Ensure reading text blocks are placed inside frosted cards for legibility.

STANDARDIZE BOTTOM TABS: The tab bar must use `expo-blur` for its background so content flows elegantly underneath. Apply safe-area padding to the bottom. Inactive tab icons should use `onSurfaceSecondary`, and the active tab gets `brandPrimary` (Antique Gold). Ensure touch targets are exactly or larger than 44x44pt.

CONSOLIDATE SPACING & RADII: Audit all StyleSheet creations to replace raw pixel values for paddings/margins/borderRadius with the exact tokens provided in this blueprint (`sm:8, md:12, lg:16, xl:24` for spacing, and `sm:6, md:12, lg:20` for radii). Do not mix card border radii on the same screen.
